result: Gradient descent on the factor U of X = UUT (factored gradient descent) with a step that scales like 1/(M‖X‖ + ‖∇f(X)‖) keeps the convex rates: O(1/k) for smooth f and linear for restricted strongly convex f, from a good initialization.
result_plain: Factored GD on UU^T keeps convex-like local rates (1/k smooth, linear strongly convex) with a norm-scaled step and a good start.
